'''Arlumek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cragmoloid/Legends|Cragmoloid]] who was the third son of [[Boulad]], an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] and [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]].

==Biography==
[[18 BBY/Legends|A year after]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was established, Boulad was visited by [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Security Officer]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]], who asked him about information about [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] locations and travels in the past. After brief negotiations, Boulad decided to hand over the information to the Captain for payment of 5,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], as it was no problem for him to infiltrate the Empire's central computer and records and obtain records that would be unattainable to normal living beings. Based on this information, Typho realized that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was responsible for the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and left the caragmoloid again.<ref name="sos" />
